transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Alex. I received an email saying my automatic payment failed. I'm pretty sure my credit card on file expired.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly help you with that. I'll just need to verify your account for security purposes. Could you please provide your Customer ID?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, of course. It's CUST-1001.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. And for the final verification step, could you please provide the 4-digit security PIN associated with your account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: My PIN is 9-8-2-8.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you, Ms. Ramirez. I have your account pulled up now. One moment while I review the billing details.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, thanks.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, I see it here. Yes, it looks like the automatic payment for your Fiber 300 plan was declined on the 15th. The reason listed is an expired card.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Ugh, I knew it. I'm so sorry, I totally forgot to update it. So, what do I owe right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No problem at all, it happens to all of us. The past due balance is just for the one billing cycle, which is fifty-five dollars.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, fifty-five. I'd like to pay that off right now with my new card if that's possible.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. And after we take care of the one-time payment, would you like me to update that new card as your default for future autopayments?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, please. That would be great. I don't want this to happen again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. Let's start with the payment. I am ready to take the card information whenever you are.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, I have it here. It's a Visa.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Please go ahead with the card number.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. And the expiration date?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: It's June of 2027. So, 0-6, 2-7.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Got it. And the 3-digit CVV code from the back of the card?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That is 3-3-4.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And finally, the billing zip code for this card?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Same as my service address, 90210.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Thank you. So I am submitting a one-time payment of fifty-five dollars to your Cymbal Telecom account. Please stay on the line, this will just take about 20 seconds to process.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, no problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Ms. Ramirez. The payment was successful. Your account balance is now zero and you are all current.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, wonderful. That's a relief.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: For your records, the confirmation number for this transaction is T-8-8-1-2-5-4-3.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Now, for the second part. You wanted to update this card for your automatic payments, correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I'm going into your autopay settings now. I see the old card here, ending in 5555, which is now marked as expired.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's the one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am now replacing it with the new card you provided. Do I have your authorization to save this Visa ending in 7461 as the primary payment method for recurring monthly charges from Cymbal Telecom?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, you do. Please go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I'm saving the changes now... and it is done. The Visa ending in 7461 is now set for all future automatic payments.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Excellent. So next month's bill will charge to this new card automatically?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is correct. Your next billing date is the 15th, and it will be charged to the new card on file.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Perfect. That's everything I needed. Thank you so much for your help.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are very welcome, Ms. Ramirez. I'm glad we could get this sorted out for you quickly.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Me too. I appreciate how easy you made it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? Any questions about your service or account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that was it. Just the payment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright then. Thank you for being a valued Cymbal Telecom customer. Have a wonderful rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too, Alex. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.
